question: Find the IDs of players who scored the highest number of partnership runs for each match. The output should include the IDs of two players, each with their individual scores and the total partnership score. For each pair, the player with the higher individual score should be listed as player 1, and the player with the lower score as player 2. In cases where both players have the same score, the player with the higher ID should be player 1, and the player with the lower ID should be player 2. There can be multiple rows for a single match.
sql:
WITH ball_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bbb.match_id,
        bbb.innings_no,
        bbb.striker,
        bbb.non_striker,
        bs.runs_scored
    FROM ball_by_ball bbb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bbb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bbb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bbb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    WHERE bbb.striker IS NOT NULL AND bbb.non_striker IS NOT NULL
),
pair_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        innings_no,
        striker,
        non_striker,
        runs_scored,
        CASE WHEN striker < non_striker THEN striker ELSE non_striker END AS lower_id,
        CASE WHEN striker < non_striker THEN non_striker ELSE striker END AS higher_id
    FROM ball_runs
),
striker_runs AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, lower_id, higher_id, 
           SUM(CASE WHEN striker = lower_id THEN runs_scored ELSE 0 END) AS runs_by_lower,
           SUM(CASE WHEN striker = higher_id THEN runs_scored ELSE 0 END) AS runs_by_higher,
           SUM(runs_scored) AS total_partnership
    FROM pair_runs
    GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, lower_id, higher_id
),
match_partnerships AS (
    SELECT match_id, lower_id, higher_id,
           SUM(runs_by_lower) AS runs_lower,
           SUM(runs_by_higher) AS runs_higher,
           SUM(total_partnership) AS partnership_runs
    FROM striker_runs
    GROUP BY match_id, lower_id, higher_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT match_id, lower_id, higher_id, runs_lower, runs_higher, partnership_runs,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY partnership_runs DESC) AS rn
    FROM match_partnerships
),
top_partnerships AS (
    SELECT match_id, lower_id, higher_id, runs_lower, runs_higher, partnership_runs
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    match_id,
    CASE WHEN runs_lower > runs_higher OR (runs_lower = runs_higher AND lower_id > higher_id) THEN lower_id ELSE higher_id END AS player_id_1,
    CASE WHEN runs_lower > runs_higher OR (runs_lower = runs_higher AND lower_id > higher_id) THEN runs_lower ELSE runs_higher END AS player_1_score,
    CASE WHEN runs_lower > runs_higher OR (runs_lower = runs_higher AND lower_id > higher_id) THEN higher_id ELSE lower_id END AS player_id_2,
    CASE WHEN runs_lower > runs_higher OR (runs_lower = runs_higher AND lower_id > higher_id) THEN runs_higher ELSE runs_lower END AS player_2_score,
    partnership_runs
FROM top_partnerships
ORDER BY match_id;
